exact_control_followup.scope: The two previously unresolved constants on the frozen text-only S-PSR panel.
exact_control_followup.coefficient_rule: For each candidate length, divide the exactly summed applied adaptive FP32 coefficients by that length and round once to nearest-even FP32.
exact_control_followup.exact_match_rule: The constant rendering must reach native EOS within the original observer length domain and use precisely the rounded FP32 coefficient for the realized patch count.
exact_control_followup.candidate_order: Increasing distance from the saved adaptive EOS count, with equal distances ordered by ascending length.
